title: Grinning Squinting Face Emoji 😆 Meaning: The XD Laugh
description: The grinning squinting face emoji 😆 is the eyes-scrunched laugh, the emoji form of XD: you found something properly funny, without the tears of 😂.
summary: The 😆 grinning squinting face means hearty laughter. Its eyes are scrunched into > < shapes and its mouth is wide open, like someone cracking up. It is the emoji form of the old XD emoticon, used for jokes, silliness, and excited delight, with a goofier, less dramatic tone than 😂.
meaning: Anyone who typed XD or >< in a chat room will recognize this face. The X is the squeezed-shut eyes and the D is the open mouth, and 😆 draws the same thing in yellow. It means the sender is laughing, and laughing in a slightly silly, unguarded way. It works well for slapstick, bad puns, and things that are funny because they are dumb.

Compared with the tear-streaked laughing faces, 😆 has more bounce and less drama. There is no suggestion of crying or collapsing. That makes it a comfortable middle setting: more than a smile, less than hysterics. People who feel 😂 is overused, or who simply laughed without losing control, often land here.

It can also express excitement that tips into giddiness. “We're going to Disney 😆” is not a joke; the squint shows someone so thrilled they are practically squealing. Younger users sometimes use it this way for fan excitement, ships, and good news about favorite shows or artists, where anime-style expressions feel at home.

The face is occasionally used when laughing at yourself. Tripping on a curb, sending a text to the wrong person, or burning dinner might each earn a 😆. There it signals that you are fine and already find the incident funny, which invites the other person to laugh along instead of worrying.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: A standard reply to a funny message, especially quick back-and-forth banter. It keeps things playful and shows you are enjoying the exchange. Because it lacks tears, it never implies that you are overwhelmed, so it suits jokes that are amusing but not legendary. Several in a row raise the volume.

contexts.label: In gaming and fandom
contexts.body: The XD lineage gives it a home on Discord, in game chats, and in fan communities. It reacts to clips of ridiculous glitches, chaotic team wipes, and in-jokes. It tends to feel friendlier than 💀, which can be biting, so it is common among groups that play together regularly.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: Fine for reacting to a colleague's joke in a casual channel. It shows you got the humor without the intensity of crying-laughing faces. Keep it away from messages about errors or missed deadlines, where laughing with your eyes shut looks like you are not taking things seriously.

examples.text: He waved back at someone who wasn't waving at him 😆
examples.meaning: Laughing at a harmless, awkward moment.

examples.text: I just said “you too” to the waiter 😆
examples.meaning: Laughing at their own small embarrassment.
The joke was bad in an enjoyable way.

examples.text: Your cat's face in this one 😆
examples.meaning: The photo is funny and the sender is delighted by it.

combos.meaning: Laughing that escalates; it started as a giggle and got out of hand.
Laughing and applauding a good joke or a well-timed comeback.
Laughing at a silly mistake, your own or a friend's.
Affectionate amusement; you are funny and I like you for it.

confusedWith.difference: 😂 has streaming tears and is the classic laughing-so-hard-I'm-crying face. 😆 has no tears and tightly scrunched eyes. It is lighter and goofier, and it has not picked up the “outdated” reputation that 😂 has with some younger users.
😣 has the same > < eyes but a wavy, clenched mouth. It shows struggle or frustration. The eyes look alike at small sizes, so check the mouth: wide open and smiling is 😆, tight and downturned is 😣.
😝 shares the scrunched eyes but sticks out its tongue. It is for teasing, mock disgust, or being playfully bratty. 😆 is laughing at something, not making a face at someone.

avoid: Don't use it when someone tells you about an accident or mistake they are upset about, since it laughs before they are ready to.
Avoid it in formal emails, where an anime-style laugh looks out of place.
design: A yellow face with a broad open mouth and eyes drawn as two angled lines meeting in a point, like > and <. Upper teeth are usually visible, and some versions include a tongue. Apple, Google, Samsung, and Microsoft all use the same structure. The squint is sharper on some platforms and softer on others, but it always signals eyes pressed shut by laughter.

faqs.a: Yes, in effect. XD is a sideways face with squeezed eyes and a big open mouth, and 😆 is the same expression drawn as an emoji. Some chat apps have converted typed XD into this face automatically.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😆 and 😂?
faqs.a: Intensity and style. 😂 says you laughed until you cried. 😆 says you laughed hard but stayed upright. 😆 also feels more playful and cartoonish, which is why it is common in gaming and fan spaces.

faqs.q: What does 😆 mean from a guy or a girl?
faqs.a: They think you, or what you said, is funny. Making someone laugh is a good sign in any conversation, including a flirtatious one, but the emoji shows amusement and comfort, not romantic intent by itself.

faqs.q: Does 😆 ever mean someone is in pain?
faqs.a: No. People occasionally mistake the scrunched eyes for wincing, but the wide smiling mouth marks it as laughter. For strain or discomfort, the similar-eyed 😣 or 😖 is the one to use.
